selection_rule.domain: ACTIVE H2 target with observed root actions; other supported inherited cases fall back to original selector
selection_rule.challenger: largest same-cache q_upper over other legal root actions; lexicographic action tie
selection_rule.signed_reach: math.fsum of empirical incumbent probabilities minus challenger probabilities for each common H1 successor
selection_rule.eligible: retained ACTIVE H1 state, nonzero signed reach, unobserved legal action with q_upper > state lower
selection_rule.fallback: original structural select_row, then inherited balanced repeat selection

generator_rule: For each fixed seed, random.Random(seed), row-major choice from ascending ranks1..10 excluding placed left/up ranks; then randint(1,10) at(0,1), then independently at(10,14). Keep all16 outputs.
expected_counts_scope: Local and total counts are full-completion upper bounds; legal early stopping is charged at actual counts and excluded from the fixed-budget primary quality mask.
run_order: List all six itertools.permutations of the canonical configuration name list; choose index (replicate_index*context_count+context_index)%6.
primary_quality_eligibility: Entire stream of all160 contexts and all3 configurations source-valid, each completes its own fixed K, each policy evaluable with valid probability and regret identities.
primary_cost_eligibility: All-source-valid complete streams independent of budget completion and quality; retain all actual fees unconditionally and also report paired costs on the common quality mask.
primary_unit: Ten queries averaged within board, sixteen boards equally; paired 95% Student t Monte Carlo intervals over new suffix streams conditional on fixed new boards and prefixes.
independent_query_cost: Current full board prefix_sampling_seconds + current full single_query_prepare_seconds + current local_whole_run_seconds; no restoration or amortization.
novelty_scope: Raw and D4 equality against the declared roots and target boards in listed novelty_sources; new seed bands checked against listed seed_registry_sources.
evidence_scope: Prospective three-configuration validation on new boards and new prefix/suffix streams within the same constructed H2 generator; candidate selected using prior development data, not a formal Gate.
